p: Begin the day by reading the five ideas, with the comments included.
pe: At the end of the day, however, be sure to review all of them once more.
ideas: Nothing I see means anything.
I have given what I see all the meaning it has for me.
I do not understand anything I see.
These thoughts do not mean anything.
I am never upset for the reason I think.
ev: Devote two minutes or more to each practice period, thinking about the idea and the related comments after reading them over. Do this as often as possible during the day.
